sources.title: colqwen3 - vLLM
sources.snippet: ColQwen3 late interaction model for multi-modal retrieval and reranking. ColQwen3 extends Qwen3-VL with a ColBERT-style late interaction head, producing per-token embeddings for both text and image inputs.
